papers.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
papers.abstract: Open-source Mixture-of-Experts multimodal foundation model for long-video understanding and agentic intelligence, featuring DeepSeek Sparse Attention for 256K context processing.

papers.title: Role-Agent: Bootstrapping LLM Agents via Dual-Role Evolution
papers.abstract: Framework enabling LLM to function as both agent and environment through bootstrapped co-evolution, improving performance via environment-aware reasoning and targeted practice.

papers.title: MemDreamer: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Long Video Understanding via Hierarchical Graph Memory and Agentic Retrieval Mechanism
papers.abstract: Framework decoupling perception and reasoning for long-video understanding through hierarchical graph memory and agentic tool-augmented retrieval mechanisms.

papers.title: SkillHarm: Lifecycle-Aware Skill-Based Attacks via Automated Construction
papers.abstract: Benchmark evaluating skill-based attacks across agent skill-use lifecycle with systematic taxonomy, revealing vulnerabilities with attack success rates up to 86.3%.

papers.title: Interpreting and Steering a Text-to-Speech Language Model with Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract: Sparse autoencoders reveal interpretable features for speech synthesis that control linguistic and prosodic attributes through latent space manipulation.

papers.title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
papers.abstract: Multi-chunk prediction framework for autoregressive video generation achieving 2.3x faster convergence and 2x inference acceleration with improved physical law adherence.

papers.title: Do Coding Agents Deceive Us? Detecting and Preventing Cheating via Capped Evaluation with Randomized Tests
papers.abstract: Framework using randomized testing with performance caps to detect shortcut exploitation in agent evaluation while preventing cheating behavior.

papers.title: IR3DE: A Linear Router for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Ridge regression-based routing method for selecting domain-expert LLMs that enables dynamic addition/removal of experts without retraining from scratch.

papers.title: The Role of Feedback Alignment in Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Research reveals step-aligned critique outperforms binary rewards by targeting specific reasoning failures, demonstrating structural alignment's importance in self-distillation.

papers.title: PsychoSafe: Eliciting Psychologically-Informed Refusals in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Psychologically-informed refusal framework improving harmful request handling through structured supportive communication with 28.1% quality improvement.

cc_updates.body: Sub-agents can now spawn their own sub-agents (up to 5 levels deep). Amazon Bedrock now reads the AWS region from ~/.aws config files when AWS_REGION isn't set. Added a search bar when browsing a marketplace's plugins in /plugin. Added model attribute to the claude_code.lines_of_code.count OTEL metric. Fixed sessions using 1M context without usage credits getting permanently stuck — the session now automatically compacts back under the standard context limit. Fixed a repeating "an image in the conversation could not be processed and was removed" error. Fixed the agents view keeping a session under Working with a busy spinner for up to 30 seconds after the worker replied. Fixed background agents potentially reading another directory's project settings when dispatched onto a pre-warmed worker. Fixed background-session attach failing with EAUTH for sessions started on an older version. Fixed a background sub-agent staying stuck as "active" in the agent panel. Fixed /model suggestions rendering with a misleading slash prefix and showing models disabled for your org.

Introducing Claude Fable 5: a Mythos-class model that we've made safe for general use. Fable's capabilities exceed those of any model we've ever made generally available. Update to version 2.1.170 for access. Fixed sessions not saving transcripts (and not appearing in --resume) when launched from the VS Code integrated terminal or any shell that inherited Claude Code environment variables.

Added --safe-mode flag (and CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE) to start Claude Code with all customizations disabled for troubleshooting. Added /cd command to move a session to a new working directory without breaking the prompt cache mid-session. Added a disableBundledSkills setting and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS environment variable to hide bundled skills, workflows, and built-in slash commands from the model. Fixed Up/Down arrows jumping to command history past the wrapped rows of a long input line. Fixed enterprise managed MCP policies not being enforced on reconnect, IDE-typed configs, --mcp-config servers, or before remote settings loaded. Fixed a ~30-50ms UI stall at the start of each turn for macOS users logged in with claude.ai credentials. Fixed claude -p being slow or appearing to hang on Windows. Fixed Remote Control getting stuck on "reconnecting" after resuming a session when an OAuth token refresh happened.
